;WITH TASKRemoveCTE AS
(SELECT DISTINCT
		 LTRIM(RTRIM(TASK_NAME))TASK_NAME 
		 ,C.TASK_USER_ID
		 ,C.PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID		
	FROM [APP_CPLS].[PHARMACY_CREATE_TASK] T with(nolock) 
	JOIN APP_CPLS.PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_CFG C with(nolock) 
		ON T.PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID=C.PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID
		WHERE TRANSFER_STATUS ='P'
)

SELECT
	MC.CID,
	T.USER_ID,
	T.ID AS TASK_ID,
	TRC.TASK_NAME,
	T.PRIORITY,
	CONVERT(INT,TRC.PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID) PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID
	FROM	
	CKOLTP.ORG_TASK T WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_INFO I WITH (NOLOCK) ON T.INFO_ID = I.ID
	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_PATIENT P WITH (NOLOCK) ON T.PATIENT_ID = P.ID AND COALESCE(P.DELETED, 0) != 1
	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.MEMBER_COVERAGE MC WITH (NOLOCK) ON	P.CID = MC.CID
	INNER JOIN TASKRemoveCTE  TRC ON TRC.TASK_NAME =I.subject AND TRC.TASK_USER_ID=T.USER_ID

	--INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_INFO OI WITH (NOLOCK) ON OI.subject = TRC.TASK_NAME
	WHERE 
	T.STATUS & 18 != 0 -- ONLY SHOW OPEN (2) AND RE-OPEN (16)
	AND T.TYPE_ID = 1 --ONLY SHOW REMINDER TASKS
	ORDER BY P.CID
